_doc: DEWY receipt for 2026-08-28 — naming ARCS's two-surface architecture (Receipt + Induction). See ADR-070, witness stub _STATE/witness/2026-08-28.jsonl, and Tao proverb tao-254.

receipts.sharp_question: What is the surface that serves pre-verbal, exploratory, can't-yet-name-it work, and how does it relate to the receipt?

dewy_vector.D: Canonize ADR-070: ARCS is TWO surfaces. Receipt = deductive/backward, records earned coherence. Induction = abductive/forward, recognizes the job-pattern (often before the human does), keeps the human honest vs ground truth, and forges the purpose-built instrument that fits. The meandering is the generative medium, not waste.
dewy_vector.E: The Folksonomist (induction engine, scripts/arcs_core.py); NOTOMATION (constitutional floor); the Receipt/DEWY/witness models (the other surface); every purpose-built instrument minted this session as induction-surface evidence.
dewy_vector.W: YEARS / constitutional — a naming of existing architecture, governs how future surfaces are classified (attest-the-past vs forge-for-a-pre-verbal-future).
dewy_vector.Y: GREEN — named live by the user as 'the whole point of ARCS', corroborated by ~7 in-session instrument-mints and prior canon (ADR-053 Tao, Folksonomist, WORLD.md Myst/Guide register). Falsifier: if all valued outputs reduce to records of already-articulated decisions, the induction surface is decoration.

receipts.surface: product thesis / architecture canon / brand identity
receipts.sharp_question: Are Receipt and Induction two SIDES of a ribbon, or one non-orientable surface? And why is the ARCS logo a Mobius strip?

dewy_vector.D: Canonize ADR-071, three claims as one object: (1) MOBIUS -- Receipt and Induction are not two sides but two traversals of ONE non-orientable surface; you walk the induction surface, keep walking, arrive at the receipt, having been on both without lifting off (the arc closes with a half-twist -> the mark is a Mobius). (2) TRIUNE MINIMUM -- 'two is unstable, three is the minimum for coherence', none-may-null, flagged VERBATIM in the Book of ARCS (Nov 2025, earliest artifact), re-derived as the Invariant Vectors Triad (OS deck) and Triune Logic (code). (3) GRAVITY WELL -- the corpus has enough coherent mass to exert a restoring force; drift is a displacement it pulls home (this session unwittingly ran the vision's own Phase-3 gauntlet on a drifted artifact and self-corrected).
dewy_vector.E: No new code. Names the two-surface pair (ADR-070) as one Mobius; Triune Logic (src/lib/ygate.ts, OS-deck triad) as the load-bearing minimum; the corpus-as-gravity-well as the mechanism of this session's self-correction; engine-sovereignty (ADR-072) as the same strip traversed over time (one freehold history, many tenant engines).
dewy_vector.W: YEARS / constitutional -- settles why the mark is a Mobius; gives a topological test (no new 'sides', only traversals) and the none-may-null test (remove one of three forces; real triad collapses to binary conflict).
dewy_vector.Y: GREEN -- triad grounded verbatim in the earliest artifact and independently re-derived across OS deck and code (arc-weld, ADR-064); Mobius is the user's own logo given its formal account; gravity evidenced by the unwitting Phase-3 self-correction. Per-claim falsifiers in the ADR.
